assets.name: Desk Lamp Arm 01
assets.processing: Original mesh, source model node hierarchy and complete 1K PBR images retained in a self-contained GLB. Added a grounding parent. No decimation or procedural substitute. The official glTF is a static pose with no skin, despite the source Blender asset also offering a rig. Original model cameras/lights excluded; room illumination is controlled by the scene.

runtimeIntegration.anchorMeaning: Original tabletop clamp contact at source origin; the lower clamp bolt is intentionally below the tabletop.
runtimeIntegration.emission: Only the desk_lamp_arm_01_light material is cloned and given warm #ffd4a2 emission at intensity 0.65. The housing retains its original PBR material. Any real scene light is separate from the GLB.
runtimeIntegration.coordinateNote: World values describe the recorded helper transform, not an intrinsic model coordinate; recalculate them if placement or scale changes.

assets.name: Classic Laptop
assets.processing: Original mesh, source model node hierarchy and complete 1K PBR images retained in a self-contained GLB. Added a grounding parent. No decimation or procedural substitute. Original model cameras/lights excluded; room illumination is controlled by the scene.

screen.uvProcessing: The original isolated screen has U 1..2 and V 0 at its top. At runtime only this mesh's geometry is cloned; physical local X/Y are projected to U/V 0..1, with V 1 at the top. This matches the site's CanvasTexture with default flipY true and keeps text upright, unmirrored.
screen.materialProcessing: Only the separate, originally untextured screen material is replaced with a MeshPhysicalMaterial using the live canvas as map/emissiveMap: emissiveIntensity 0.48, roughness 0.38, specularIntensity 0.18, clearcoat 0.35, clearcoatRoughness 0.4. Restrained glass reflections preserve screen readability. Housing, keyboard, hinges and all their original PBR maps remain unchanged.
